title: Blink Sync Module shows offline
shortDescription: Sync Module disconnected from WiFi or cloud.
fullDescription:
The Blink Sync Module is the hub between cameras and the cloud. When offline, all linked cameras stop responding. The module's blue and green LEDs indicate health: solid blue + solid green means connected; flashing blue means setup mode.

Most offline issues come from WiFi changes or stale DHCP leases.

fixSteps.title: Check LEDs
fixSteps.instruction: Solid blue + solid green = healthy. Flashing blue = setup mode.

fixSteps.title: Reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 10 seconds, replug. Wait 60 seconds for reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Reset and re-add
fixSteps.instruction: Hold reset button 10 seconds until LED flashes red. Re-add via Blink app.

faq.q: Can I use Blink without sync module?
faq.a: Mini cameras can run without it; outdoor/XT need it.

title: Blink camera thumbnail will not refresh
shortDescription: Thumbnail refresh fails or is stuck on old image.
fullDescription:
Blink cameras refresh their thumbnail on demand. If refresh fails, the camera may be in low-battery state, weak WiFi, or out of range of the Sync Module.

Replacing batteries and moving the camera closer to the Sync Module solves most cases.

causes.cause: Weak signal between camera and module

fixSteps.title: Replace batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Use fresh AA lithium (not alkaline) batteries.

fixSteps.title: Move closer
fixSteps.instruction: Bring camera within 30 ft of Sync Module to confirm.

faq.a: Lithium handles cold and lasts much longer in low-current Blink cameras.

title: Blink camera not recording motion clips
shortDescription: Motion happens but no clip is saved.
fullDescription:
Blink cameras only record motion when the system is armed and the camera is enabled in the active schedule. If clips stop, check arming state, motion sensitivity, and the activity zone.

Cloud storage trial expiry also stops new clips from saving.
symptoms: No new entries in Clips list
Camera obviously sees motion (live view shows it)

fixSteps.title: Arm system
fixSteps.instruction: On home screen, tap the running-man icon to arm.

fixSteps.title: Check subscription
fixSteps.instruction: Account > Subscription. Renew Blink Plus or use local storage.

faq.a: Yes, with Sync Module 2 + USB drive.

title: 'Camera busy' when starting live view
shortDescription: Camera busy error blocks live stream attempt.
fullDescription:
'Camera busy' usually means the camera is currently uploading a clip, or another user in your shared account is viewing it. Wait 30 seconds and retry.

Persistent busy errors can indicate firmware hang; reboot the camera.

fixSteps.title: Reboot camera
fixSteps.instruction: Pull batteries (or unplug if wired) for 15 seconds.

faq.q: Can I view simultaneously with my partner?
faq.a: Only one viewer at a time per camera.

title: Blink Outdoor batteries last weeks instead of years
shortDescription: Battery icon drops to low within weeks.
fullDescription:
Blink Outdoor advertises 2-year battery life on AA lithium. Heavy motion areas, frequent live view, and high-sensitivity settings drain much faster. Cold weather (<-4F) also reduces life.

Reducing motion sensitivity, retrigger time, and clip length helps.

fixSteps.title: Use lithium AA
fixSteps.instruction: Switch to Energizer Ultimate Lithium AA only.

fixSteps.title: Activity zones
fixSteps.instruction: Mask areas with constant motion (street, trees).

fixSteps.title: Solar panel
fixSteps.instruction: Install Blink Solar Panel for permanent charge.

faq.a: Not recommended; voltage curves trigger early low-battery.

title: Sync Module 2 will not recognize USB drive
shortDescription: Local storage USB drive not detected.
fullDescription:
Sync Module 2 supports USB drives 1-256GB formatted as FAT32 or exFAT for local clip storage. Some drives draw too much power and fail to mount.

Use a low-power flash drive (not an external HDD) and format in the Blink app.

causes.cause: Drive too large or wrong format

fixSteps.title: Verify Sync Module 2
fixSteps.instruction: Sync Module 1 has no USB support.

fixSteps.title: Format in app
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Local Storage > Format USB drive.

videoSearchQuery: Blink sync module USB drive not detected

faq.a: Not officially supported; some users report success with bus-powered SSDs.

title: Blink Outdoor night image is dark or washed out
shortDescription: Night vision IR image is unusable.
fullDescription:
Blink Outdoor uses IR LEDs for night vision. If the IR LEDs are dirty, blocked by mounting, or the lens is obstructed by spider webs, the image will be black or fully white from glare.

Keep lens clean and IR setting on Auto or High.

causes.cause: Spider web in front of camera

fixSteps.title: Clean lens
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe lens and IR window with microfiber cloth.

fixSteps.title: Adjust IR intensity
fixSteps.instruction: Camera settings > Night Vision Intensity: try Medium.

fixSteps.title: Reposition
fixSteps.instruction: Move camera away from reflective walls and backlit windows.

faq.q: Why are spiders attracted to Blink?
faq.a: IR LEDs heat draws insects, which draw spiders.

title: Blink camera temperature out of operating range
shortDescription: Camera reports too hot or too cold to operate.
fullDescription:
Blink Outdoor operates from -4F to 113F. Outside this range, the camera enters protect mode and stops recording until temperature normalizes.

Direct sun on the camera body in summer and severe winter cold are common triggers.
symptoms: Camera offline during heat or cold

fixSteps.title: Add shade
fixSteps.instruction: Mount camera under eaves or add a sun visor.

fixSteps.title: Lithium batteries
fixSteps.instruction: Lithium handles cold to -40F unlike alkaline.

title: Blink Video Doorbell press not detected
shortDescription: Pressing the doorbell button does nothing.
fullDescription:
Blink Video Doorbell can run on batteries or wired to a transformer. If wired, requires a Sync Module to chime existing mechanical bell. Battery-only mode requires Sync Module too for chime functionality.

Verify the Sync Module is present and the camera is paired to it.
symptoms: App push works but mechanical chime silent

fixSteps.title: Verify Sync Module
fixSteps.instruction: Doorbell needs Sync Module to ring chime; without it only app gets notified.

fixSteps.title: Wired mode
fixSteps.instruction: If hardwired, ensure 16-24V AC transformer and proper wiring.

faq.a: For chime functions and event recording, yes.

title: System randomly toggles between armed and disarmed
fullDescription:
Schedules in the Blink app can cause unexpected arm/disarm cycles. Multiple users sharing an account can also trigger toggles. Geofencing in the Blink app pre-2024 was unreliable.

Review schedules and remove unused ones.

fixSteps.title: Review schedules
fixSteps.instruction: App > System Settings > Schedule. Delete duplicates.

fixSteps.title: Check Alexa routines
fixSteps.instruction: Alexa app > Routines. Disable any that arm/disarm Blink.

faq.a: Limited; use schedules or Alexa routines instead.

title: Blink Sync Module shows offline
shortDescription: All cameras unreachable; Sync Module red LED.
fullDescription: Sync Module offline blocks all cameras. Caused by Wi-Fi disconnect, USB power loss, or firmware glitch.

fixSteps.title: Re-add module
fixSteps.instruction: Delete and re-pair if reboot doesn't fix.

title: Blink camera not responding
shortDescription: Specific camera shows Camera busy or unresponsive.
fullDescription: Single-camera offline despite Sync Module online points to dead batteries, signal too weak, or camera firmware crash.

fixSteps.title: Move closer to Sync
fixSteps.instruction: Distance under 100 ft, no thick walls.

videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera CAMERA UNRESPONSIVE fix

title: Blink camera weak signal warning
shortDescription: Signal bars at 1-2 in app; missed motion clips.
fullDescription: Sub-Gigahertz LFR signal between camera and Sync Module weakens through brick, foil insulation, or 100+ ft distance.
videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera WEAK SIGNAL fix

title: Blink camera low battery alert
shortDescription: Battery icon red; clip duration shortened.
fullDescription: Cold weather, frequent live view, and motion-heavy zones drain Blink AA cells fast. Lithium cells last 2 years; alkalines 3-6 months.

fixSteps.title: Reduce sensitivity
fixSteps.instruction: Lower Motion sensitivity to limit triggers.

videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera LOW BATTERY fix

title: Blink thumbnail update fails
fullDescription: Thumbnail capture fails when camera signal is weak or Sync Module is busy. Often a transient issue cleared by retry.
videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera THUMBNAIL FAILED fix

title: Blink local USB drive full
shortDescription: Sync Module 2 USB shows storage full.
fullDescription: Sync Module 2 supports USB local storage up to 256GB. When full, oldest clips are not auto-deleted unless setting enabled.
videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera CLIP STORAGE FULL fix

title: Blink setup error 1003
shortDescription: Sync Module pairing fails with error 1003.
fullDescription: Error 1003 means the QR code on the bottom of the Sync Module wasn't read or the module timed out. Reset and re-scan.
videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera SETUP ERROR 1003 fix

title: Blink live view times out at 30s
fullDescription: By design Blink limits live view to conserve battery. Subscription plan extends duration; otherwise use Plus Plan.

fixSteps.title: Subscribe
fixSteps.instruction: Plus Plan extends live view to 90s.

videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera LIVE VIEW TIMEOUT fix

title: Blink activity zones not saving
fullDescription: Activity zones may fail to save if app cache is stale or camera firmware predates the feature.
videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera MOTION ZONES NOT SAVING fix

title: Blink temperature reading inaccurate
fullDescription: Camera-mounted temp sensor reads ambient near electronics; sun exposure or housing heat causes inaccurate reads.

fixSteps.title: Replace camera
fixSteps.instruction: If sensor stays bad after cool-down (warranty).

videoSearchQuery: Blink security camera TEMPERATURE SENSOR FAIL fix

title: Blink Sync Module 2 offline after firmware
fullDescription: Sync Module 2 firmware push can hang. Solid red LED means it lost cloud auth. Reset via the small pinhole next to USB.

fixSteps.title: Pinhole reset 10s
fixSteps.instruction: Insert paperclip until LED flashes red, release.

fixSteps.title: Remove USB drive
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug USB clip storage and re-add later.

fixSteps.title: Re-add to system
fixSteps.instruction: App > delete sync module > add new.

title: Blink no live stream available banner
fullDescription: Banner appears when sync module is online but UDP holes can't open. Caused by carrier-grade NAT, restrictive firewall, or 5GHz drop.

title: Blink Video Doorbell pairing fails repeatedly
shortDescription: Doorbell won't pair to sync module.
fullDescription: Pairing failures from low batteries, wired-mode resistor missing, or sync module out of range. Use fresh AAs even if battery indicator looks ok.

title: Blink sync module firmware update failed
shortDescription: App says sync module update failed.
fullDescription: Update can fail when USB drive too large, or sync module placed too far from router.

fixSteps.title: Retry update
fixSteps.instruction: App > sync module > check for update.

title: Blink camera thumbnail won't refresh
shortDescription: Thumbnail shows old image even when refreshed.
fullDescription: Thumbnail caching glitch after sync module reboot. Manual capture via app forces refresh.

title: Blink Mini solid red LED
shortDescription: Mini camera shows solid red LED.
fullDescription: Solid red on Mini means lost connection to cloud. Power cycle and re-add to system.

title: Blink Outdoor 4 batteries drain in weeks
fullDescription: Outdoor 4 should run 2 years on lithiums. Fast drain means motion sensitivity too high, retrigger interval too short, or alkaline batteries used in cold.

title: Blink USB clip storage full
shortDescription: Sync Module 2 reports USB storage full.
fullDescription: Sync Module 2 stops saving local clips when USB drive fills. Auto-overwrite is off by default.

fixSteps.title: Enable auto-overwrite
fixSteps.instruction: Sync module settings > Local storage > overwrite oldest.

title: Blink Video Doorbell mechanical chime won't ring
fullDescription: Wired Blink doorbell needs compatible 16-24VAC chime and bypass kit if digital. Without bypass, mechanical chime can stay silent.

title: Blink motion clips cut to 5 seconds
fullDescription: Default clip length is 5s for free tier; bumping to 30s/60s requires Blink Subscription Plus.
